in_arabic.name: Mietaa
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mietaa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'mi't, meaning 'light breeze.' This name is often given to girls in Muslim culture to symbolize the soft and calming presence of the wind.
